Magnesium sulfate is one of the drugs that has been used for seizure prophylaxis in patients with porphyria (p.471) who continue to experience convulsions while in remission. Premature labour. Magnesium sulfate has been given intra- venously to suppress initial uterine contractions in the manage- ment of premature labour1-3 (p.2003). Although it has been found to possess similar efficacy to beta2 agonists,4,5 and is widely used, in particular in the USA, a systematic review6 concluded it was ineffective at delaying birth or preventing preterm birth.
